plugin.name: Computer Use
plugin.description: Inspect and operate desktop apps with access you can remember and revoke on macOS.
plugin.longDescription: An optional desktop connection using Open Computer Use. On macOS, allow an app once or remember access across conversations; revoke it in Settings. Windows/Linux ask per call. Requires Node.js/npm and OS accessibility permissions; macOS screenshots also need Screen Recording. The first connection downloads a pinned native runtime with your account permissions. Screenshots and UI text go to your selected model. Setup and limitations are in the README.
server.title: Desktop
